title: Linden Memberships Insurance Billing and Self-Pay Discount Table
content:
For each tier of Linden Memberships, patient financial services records two billing settings and two discounts: whether member primary care visits are also billed to the member's insurance; whether no copay or visit charge applies to member primary care visits (a setting that applies only where insurance is not billed); the percentage discount on in-house lab panels for self-paid labs; and the percentage discount on self-paid in-house imaging.

## Table

| Tier | Member primary care visits billed to insurance | No copay or visit charge on member primary care visits | Discount on self-paid in-house lab panels | Discount on self-paid in-house imaging |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Linden Connect Virtual Membership | Yes | No | 0% | 0% |
| Linden Essential Membership | No | Yes | 40% | 20% |
| Linden Family Membership | No | Yes | 40% | 20% |
| Linden Plus Membership | Yes | No | 50% | 25% |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | Yes | No | 60% | 30% |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | Yes | No | 100% | 50% |

## Points of judgement

- The Linden Essential Membership and the Linden Family Membership are the two tiers whose member primary care visits are not billed to insurance, and they are the two tiers on which no copay or visit charge applies to those visits.
- On the Linden Connect Virtual Membership, Linden Plus Membership, Linden Premier Concierge Membership and Linden Executive Health Membership, member primary care visits are billed to the member's insurance.
- The discount percentages apply to self-paid in-house lab panels and self-paid in-house imaging. The Linden Connect Virtual Membership carries no discount on either (0%). A discount of 100%, as on lab panels under the Linden Executive Health Membership, leaves nothing to pay on a self-paid in-house lab panel.

## Hypothetical illustration

A self-paid in-house imaging study priced at 400.00 (hypothetical price) is discounted by 30% under the Linden Premier Concierge Membership, a discount of 120.00, leaving 280.00; under the Linden Essential Membership the discount is 20%, that is 80.00, leaving 320.00.
